# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent = seed (cand_0001 was REJECTED and reverted: it fixed 53161 but broke 160-6). I
diagnosed all seed trajectories with 4 parallel read-only subagents (one per cluster group),
each cross-checking ground truth at `…/spreadsheetbench-data/sample_data_200/spreadsheet/<id>/`.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read-computed-value gap | 374-9 (t0 fails even variant 1) | Agent reads source cells WITHOUT `data_only`, so a formula column (col H `=SUM(...)`) comes back as the formula STRING, `float()` skips it → sum too low. t1/t2 (data_only/pandas) pass variant 1. | KNOWLEDGE / method | Missing-rule: read computed values, never formula text; recompute None caches |
| 2 | Cross-copy brittleness (hardcoding) | 53161, 52216 | Final block replayed on 3 copies w/ different data/layout; agent bakes in preview values (52216 rows 15/16), fixed col/row indices + `==1` marker tests (53161 t1) → breaks on other copies | KNOWLEDGE / STRUCTURE | Re-apply proven task_template cross-copy section (fixed 53161 in cand_0001) + brittle-test + leave-already-correct-cells |
| 3 | Type / precision mismatch | 418-29, 52216 | Blanket `float()` writes `0.0` where gold holds int `0`; wrong type graded as MISMATCH | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | Type-preservation rule (redesigned — NO date coercion) + verify-type check |
| 4 | Row-deletion under-deletes | 347-49 (always 0) | Agent deletes only literally-blank rows / stops at first non-blank row; gold deletes the whole separator block (blank rows + "Employee Info" label + "Gross Pay" header row). Instruction GIVES example ranges (rows 29–36) that reveal the true block extent. | KNOWLEDGE / worked-example | Deletion-calibration rule using the instruction's own example ranges |
| — | Data-defect capped | 374-9 (≤1/3), 52216/418-29 (identical inputs → divergent answers) | Ground truth internally inconsistent — no rule reproduces all 3 variants | ENVIRONMENT/DATA | Recover only the controllable part (read-value + type); documented ceiling |
| — | Unwinnable / infra (SKIP) | 32468 (corrupted gold), 55457 + 47484 (infra timeouts) | 32468: DISCOUNT!row = 6.5 in every input but −7 in every answer (gold computed on mutated cell), cell-level all-or-nothing. 55457/47484: `sandbox exec … Read timed out`, mean ~0 | ENVIRONMENT | none (handed back) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — multiple lever types)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | missing-rule (KNOWLEDGE) | prompt.md | "Read COMPUTED values, not formula text (data_only/pandas); a formula cell reads back as its string and must not be skipped/treated as 0; recompute None caches." Applies to ANY task reading formula/subtotal source cells. | Yes — 40467/160-6 read only literal values → no-op |
| 3 | output-contract | prompt.md | "Preserve each source value's original TYPE — do NOT coerce": text stays text (incl. date-like strings like `'2022/09/08'`), int stays int (`0` not `0.0`), no unrequested rounding. REDESIGN of cand_0001's type rule with the date-coercion clause REMOVED. | Yes — explicitly keeps date-text as text (the exact thing that broke 160-6) and text as text (40467) |
| 2 | missing-rule / structure | prompt.md + task_template.md | "Compute from the CURRENT file at run time; never hardcode preview values/positions/counts; no brittle `==1` tests; locate by header/label + data extent." task_template re-adds the "re-run on 3 copies" section that FIXED 53161 in cand_0001, plus "leave already-correct cells untouched" (52216 C15). | Yes — 40467/160-6 already inspect each run; edit only reinforces data-driven code |
| 4 | worked-example (KNOWLEDGE) | prompt.md | "When a DELETE instruction gives example row ranges, reproduce them exactly; a separator block includes label/header rows, not just blanks; walk dynamically, don't stop at first non-blank row; leave true data rows." General (no task-specific anchors like 'Gross Pay' hardcoded). | Yes — fires only when instruction gives delete-example ranges; 40467 (cell-level) & 160-6 (blank-gap shift, no separator labels) unaffected |
| 3/2 | structure (verify) | task_template.md | Verify step 3 upgraded: print value AND Python type for written cells, confirm type + nothing outside range. Explicitly "cells the instruction leaves blank stay blank" so it does NOT pressure filling 160-6's blanks. | Yes — passing tasks already re-open & verify; blank-preservation clause protects 160-6 |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 374-9 t0 (read `input` w/o data_only → col H = `'=SUM(A7:G7)'` skipped → "12 cells LOWER"): read-computed-value rule → agent uses data_only/pandas, includes H, matches variant 1 exactly (t1/t2 already do). Converts flaky 0.22 → stable ~0.33 (its data-defect ceiling). Passing tasks read no formulas → unchanged.
- 418-29 t2 (agent writes `0.0`, gold holds int `0` → "float where int expected"): type rule "write whole number as int, no blanket float()" → int `0`. (Value defect on v2/v3 is inconsistent gold; only the type part is controllable — documented.)
- 52216 (agent hardcoded variant-1 lists into rows 15/16; overwrote C15 which should stay): cross-copy "compute from current file, don't paste preview numbers" + "leave already-correct cells untouched" → agent computes row 16 live and leaves row 15.
- 53161 t1 (hardcoded `range(6,14)`, fixed rows, `v == 1`): cross-copy dynamic-location rule (the one that fixed 53161 in cand_0001) + "no brittle `==1` tests, treat any non-empty/non-zero as a mark" → matches the passing trials' approach.
- 347-49 t0/t2 (deletes only blank rows / stops at first non-blank "Employee Info" → +40 retained cells, row-shift mismatch): deletion-calibration rule directs the agent to inspect the instruction's example ranges (rows 29–36), see they cover the Employee Info + header rows, and delete the whole block dynamically. General; no gold values leaked.
- SAFE re 160-6 (the cand_0001 regression): subagent A confirmed the ONLY cand_0001 edit that changed 160-6 was the "write real dates not string forms" clause (its Start-Plan-Date column is stored as TEXT and the gold keeps it text). That clause is DROPPED; the new type rule explicitly keeps date-like strings as text. All other edits are no-ops on 160-6.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents — (A) why cand_0001 broke 160-6, (B) 347-49 deletion semantics, (C) flaky near-misses 52216/418-29/53161, (D) 374-9 cap + 40467 protection. Each verified against the 3 ground-truth variants. Synthesized here.
- Prior iterations read: `./prior_iterations/cand_0001/` PROCESS.md + diff.patch, LEDGER, JOURNAL, RUNMAP, and the two auto-memories (libreoffice-recalc-active, spreadsheetbench-ground-truth-data). Learned: (i) the exact 160-6 breaker, (ii) the cross-copy edit fixed 53161 and is safe, (iii) the FORMULA lever is REFUTED (regressed 52216/53161 in a prior run) — so I compute literals from live reads instead.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Keep "Prefer LITERAL values over live formulas" — load-bearing for 40467 (a formula there emits date serials). Do NOT flip to formulas (refuted: regressed 52216/53161).
- 160-6 writes explicit blanks (None) inside its range AND stores dates as TEXT — never add a rule forbidding blank cells, requiring every cell be present, or converting date-like text to dates.
- The strict "modify ONLY answer_position" constraint and the inspect→write→verify loop.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 32468: CORRUPTED GOLD (source cell mutated vs answer; cell-level all-or-nothing) — unwinnable by any method. Handed back.
- 55457, 47484: infrastructure timeouts (`sandbox exec … Read timed out`), mean ~0 — environment noise, not prompt-fixable.
- 374-9 beyond variant 1, 52216/418-29 value cells on v2/v3: internally inconsistent ground truth (identical inputs → divergent answers) — I recover only the controllable read-value/type parts and do not overfit to the defect.
